newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin, weak tone - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin, weak tone - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday Thursday were limited in a weak tone following brisk trading this week, market sources said.
About 500 head sold at $103.50 per cwt on a dressed basis and $64.00 on a live basis in very slow trading, with not enough sold to fully test the market, they said.
The bulk of this week's cattle sales were at $104.00 to $105.00/dressed and $64.75/live.
This week's sales totaled about 106,000 head, well above estimated showlists up to 95,000. Next week's showlists were seen unchanged to smaller than this week's estimate.
